rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides access to YouMind content through a craft retrieval interface. Built with FastMCP, it enables clients to fetch plain text content from YouMind crafts using their unique IDs. Authentication is handled via browser session tokens extracted from YouMind cookies, making it useful for integrating personal YouMind content into AI workflows and knowledge management systems.
